alternative_explanations: The independent possible-output bound may already capture nearly all useful pruning, leaving pair interactions too weak to repay certificate construction.
Uniform held-out programs may make meta co-label agreement uninformative, so frozen or current-support selection may match or beat it.
confounds: The visible finite 256-program class is a narrow exact-search screen and cannot establish open-ended program induction or an LLM successor.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless every causal role has accuracy, program_induction_accuracy and length_extrapolation_accuracy exactly 1.0 in every cell and matches complete enumerative MDL.
Discard unless the meta role has strictly fewer mean_search_ops and lower workload_ops_r1, workload_ops_r4 and workload_ops_r16 than support-only, frozen and enumerative MDL in every K/depth cell.
Discard if state exceeds 16777216 bytes, any mandatory control is incomplete, any declared full-cost metric is missing, or an implementable complete control Pareto-dominates the meta role.

outcome_policy.negative: If quality or certificate correctness fails, discard the exact implementation rule; infrastructure or integrity failure is inconclusive and ends this wake without a second experiment.
outcome_policy.null: If exactness holds but meta selection fails any every-cell node, workload or Pareto gate, falsify this exact one-pair co-label-selection and exhaustive-certificate rule without tuning.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0056 testing only if exactness and every-cell node, R1, R4, R16 and Pareto gates all pass; then preregister unchanged three-seed replication.

predicted_outcome: Freeze PATTERN_COUNT=1. All roles verify the all-zero program as initial incumbent, then run the same complete DFS with bit order 0..7 and value order 0 then 1. A pattern is one unordered pair of distinct observed support bitstrings. One shared selector ranks every available pair by descending number of source rows with equal labels, then descending co-observed row count, then lexicographic first tape and second tape; meta source is deduplicated training-support rows, support source is the current support row, and frozen source is zero rows. If a ranked pair is absent, take the first ranked available pair; fewer than two constraints uses only the base bound. At partial prefix p, construction enumerates every full 8-bit program extending p and records mask S_p of its two outputs. An independent second enumeration must reproduce exactly the same mask and completion count 2^(8-|p|); otherwise reject the pattern for that node and use only the existing independent possible-output bound. The certified mismatch bound is B_ind plus min_(x,y in S_p)([x!=t_a]+[y!=t_b]) minus [t_a absent from proj_1(S_p)] minus [t_b absent from proj_2(S_p)]; tuple components two and three remain 1+assigned-one-count and partial numeric code. Cache key is the ordered tape pair, prefix depth and partial numeric code; only certified masks are cached. Construction, verification, rejection, cache lookup, pair scoring, support reads, initial-incumbent scoring, every node, leaf, execution, byte and stored mask are charged. Exactness is mandatory. The expected outcome is a stringent null because certification may exceed the saved search work.
